title: Tailwind
label: Tailwind
desc: Utility-first CSS framework that emits only the classes your markup uses, configured directly in CSS.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install Tailwind v4 as a Vite plugin or a standalone CLI build, then import it once.

snippets.code:
# Vite plugin: the usual path for a bundled app
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite

# Standalone CLI: compiles a static stylesheet without a bundler
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css --watch
